columns.name: invocation_id
columns.description: Global sequence starting at 1 across all shards; not a pod UID.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Pseudonymous namespace identifier, stable across shards.

columns.name: container_group_id
columns.description: Keyed pseudonym of the normalized image-repository multiset, stable across namespaces and shards.

columns.name: created_time
columns.unit: milliseconds from the private trace origin

columns.name: deleted_time
columns.description: Blank means unavailable, not necessarily ordinary censoring.

columns.name: requested_cpu
columns.description: Positive declared aggregate request after downward power-of-two rounding.

columns.name: requested_memory_mib
columns.description: Nonnegative declared aggregate request after rounding; source zero preserved.

columns.name: limit_cpu
columns.description: Rounded aggregate limit only when all represented containers have a CPU limit.

columns.name: limit_memory_mib
columns.description: Rounded aggregate limit; source zero and missing remain distinct.

columns.name: num_containers
columns.description: Positive number of represented regular containers.

invariants: Invocation IDs are consecutive across the ordered shards.
A known deletion timestamp is not before creation.
A present limit is not below the corresponding request.
A limit-presence flag is true exactly when the corresponding aggregate limit is present.
The represented-container count is stable for an image-bundle ID.
